title: Fun with Shapes: 2D Shapes, Sides, Corners and Lines
seo_title: 2D Shapes, Sides, Corners and Lines Class 3 Worksheet with Answers (Maths Mela Chapter 5)
standard_code: Class 3, Maths Mela Chapter 5: Fun with Shapes
standard_text: 2D shapes: identifying and describing triangles, squares, rectangles, circles and other shapes by their sides and corners; making shapes; straight lines (summary of NCERT Maths Mela Class 3)
meta_desc: Class 3 Fun with Shapes worksheet (Maths Mela Chapter 5): triangles, squares, rectangles and other shapes, sides, corners and lines. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: Name a shape by counting its sides.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • 3 sides: triangle. 4 sides: quadrilateral (square, rectangle …). 5 sides: pentagon. 6 sides: hexagon.
  • A square has 4 equal sides and 4 right angles.

Examples

Example

A shape has 6 straight sides. What is it?

6 sides

Answer: A hexagon

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Thinking a turned square is not a squareTurning a shape does not change it.
Counting a curved edge as a sideSides are straight.

faq.a: Any flat shape with 4 straight sides.
Yes: it has 4 right angles, and its sides are all equal.

items.q: What is the name of this shape?
items.e: It has 4 equal sides and 4 right angles, so it is a square. It is only turned. “Diamond” is not the maths name.

items.q: Name this 2-D shape.
items.e: It has 4 sides and 4 right angles. The long sides are longer than the short sides, so it is a rectangle, not a square. Turning a shape or making it bigger or smaller does not change its name.

items.q: What is this shape called?
items.e: It has 3 straight sides and 3 vertices, so it is a triangle. It is upside down, but it is still a triangle.

items.q: What is the name of this shape?
items.e: It has 3 straight sides and 3 vertices, so it is a triangle. A long, thin triangle is still a triangle.

items.q: Name this 2-D shape.
items.e: Count the sides: 5 straight sides make a pentagon.

items.q: What is this shape called?
items.e: Count the sides: 5 straight sides make a pentagon. The sides do not have to be equal.

items.q: What is the name of this shape?
items.e: Count the sides: 6 straight sides make a hexagon.

items.q: Name this 2-D shape.
items.e: Count the sides: 6 straight sides make a hexagon. The sides do not have to be equal.

items.q: What is this shape called?
items.e: Count the sides: 8 straight sides make an octagon.

items.q: What is the name of this shape?
items.e: Count the sides: 8 straight sides make an octagon. Count the short sides at the corners too.
It is half of a circle: 1 curved side and 1 straight side. It is a semicircle.

items.q: What is this shape called?
items.e: It is flat and perfectly round, so it is a circle. A sphere is a 3-D shape, like a ball.

items.q: How many sides does this shape have?
items.e: Count each side once. Put a finger on one side and go round until you are back where you started: 6 sides. The shape has the same number of sides and vertices.

items.q: How many vertices does this shape have?
items.e: Count each vertex once. Put a finger on one vertex and go round until you are back where you started: 5 vertices. The shape has the same number of sides and vertices.

items.q: How many vertices does this shape have?
items.e: Count each vertex once. Put a finger on one vertex and go round until you are back where you started: 8 vertices. The shape has the same number of sides and vertices.

items.q: A 2-D shape has 6 straight sides. What is it called?
items.e: 6 sides: hexagon. 5 sides: pentagon. 8 sides: octagon.

items.q: How many vertices does a pentagon have?
items.e: A pentagon has 5 sides and 5 vertices (corners). A shape with straight sides has the same number of sides and vertices.
A semicircle has 1 straight side (along the bottom) and 1 curved side.

items.q: Which shape is a hexagon?
items.e: C has 6 sides, so it is a hexagon. The others have 5, 8 and 4 sides. A hexagon does not need equal sides.

items.q: Which shape is a square?
items.e: B has 4 equal sides and 4 right angles. It is a square that has been turned. The other diamond shape has equal sides but no right angles, so it is not a square.

items.q: Which shape is a quadrilateral?
items.e: Shape A has 4 straight sides and is closed. The others have 3 sides, 5 sides or a curved side.

items.q: Which shape is a quadrilateral?
items.e: Shape A has 4 straight sides and is closed, even though it is turned. The others have 6 sides, an open gap or 3 sides.

items.q: How many sides does every quadrilateral have?
items.e: Quad means 4. Every quadrilateral has 4 straight sides, 4 vertices and 4 angles.

items.q: Is this shape a quadrilateral?
items.e: Count the sides: 4 straight sides, and the shape is closed. A quadrilateral can have a corner that points in.

items.q: Is this shape a quadrilateral?
items.e: Count carefully: it has 5 sides, so it is a pentagon, not a quadrilateral.

items.q: Is this shape a quadrilateral?
items.e: The two ends do not meet, so the shape is not closed. A quadrilateral must be a closed shape.

items.q: Is this shape a quadrilateral?
items.e: One side is curved. A quadrilateral has 4 straight sides, so this shape is not one.

items.q: Which shape is NOT a quadrilateral?
items.e: Shape B has a curved side. The other three shapes have 4 straight sides, so they are quadrilaterals.

items.q: How many sides does this shape have?
items.e: It has 3 sides, so it is a triangle, not a quadrilateral.

items.q: Varun drew a closed shape with 4 straight sides. All 4 sides are different lengths. Is it a quadrilateral?
c: Only if it is a square
items.e: Any closed shape with 4 straight sides is a quadrilateral. The sides can be different lengths and the angles can be any size.

items.q: What is the best name for this shape? Use the marks.
items.e: The arrows show exactly one pair of parallel sides. The other two sides are not parallel, so it is a trapezium.

items.q: What is the best name for this shape? Use the marks.
items.e: The arrows show exactly one pair of parallel sides. The other two sides are not parallel, so it is a trapezium. Turning a shape does not change its name.

items.q: What is the best name for this shape? Use the marks.
items.e: The small squares show 4 right angles, so it is a rectangle. The tick marks show that only opposite sides are equal, so it is not a square.

items.q: A quadrilateral has exactly one pair of parallel sides. What is it called?
items.e: Exactly one pair of parallel sides: that is a trapezium. Parallelograms, rectangles and rhombuses have 2 pairs.

items.q: What is the best name for this shape? Use the marks.
items.e: The tick marks show 4 equal sides, so it is a rhombus. There are no right-angle marks, so it is not a square.

items.q: What is the best name for this shape? Use the marks.
items.e: The small squares show 4 right angles, so it is a rectangle. The tick marks show that only opposite sides are equal, so it is not a square.

items.q: What is the best name for this shape? Use the marks.
items.e: The tick marks show 4 equal sides, so it is a rhombus. There are no right-angle marks, so it is not a square. Turning a shape does not change its name.

items.q: What is the best name for this shape? Use the marks.
items.e: The tick marks show 4 equal sides, and the small squares show 4 right angles. That makes it a square. It is also a rectangle and a rhombus, but square is the best name because it tells the most. Turning a shape does not change its name.

items.q: What is the best name for this shape? Use the marks.
items.e: Opposite sides are equal (and parallel), but there are no right angles and the sides are not all equal. It is a parallelogram, not a rectangle or a rhombus. Turning a shape does not change its name.

items.q: What is the best name for this shape? Use the marks.
items.e: The tick marks show 4 equal sides, so it is a rhombus. There are no right-angle marks, so it is not a square. Turning a shape does not change its name.

items.q: A closed shape has 4 straight sides, and all 4 sides are the same length. Which name must fit it?
items.e: 4 equal sides is all a rhombus needs. It is a square only if it also has 4 right angles, and we do not know that.

items.q: What do shape A and shape B both have?
items.e: Both shapes have the same tick mark on all 4 sides. Only the square has right angles.

items.q: How many right angles does this shape have?
items.e: Only one corner has the right-angle mark. The other 3 angles are bigger or smaller than a right angle.

items.q: Which attribute does every quadrilateral have?
items.e: Every quadrilateral has 4 sides. Right angles, equal sides and parallel sides belong only to some quadrilaterals.

items.q: How many sides of a rhombus are the same length?
items.e: A rhombus is a quadrilateral with 4 equal sides.

items.q: Which attribute do a square and a rhombus always share?
items.e: Both have 4 equal sides. A square also has 4 right angles, but most rhombuses do not.

items.q: What does every rectangle have that not every parallelogram has?
items.e: All parallelograms have 2 pairs of parallel sides and 4 vertices. A rectangle is the kind with 4 right angles.

items.q: How many pairs of parallel sides does a parallelogram have?
items.e: A parallelogram has 2 pairs of parallel sides: top and bottom, and left and right. (4 is the number of sides, not pairs.)

items.q: What do shape A and shape B both have?
items.e: Both are quadrilaterals with 4 sides. Only the rectangle has right angles, and only the rhombus has 4 equal sides.

items.q: Which shape has exactly one pair of parallel sides?
items.e: Shape B has arrows on only one pair of sides. The others have arrows on 2 pairs of sides.

items.q: What do shape A and shape B both have?
items.e: Both shapes have right-angle marks in all 4 corners. Only the square has 4 equal sides.

items.q: Which attribute do a square and a rectangle always share?
items.e: Both have 4 right angles. A square also has 4 equal sides, but most rectangles do not.

items.q: What does every square have that not every rectangle has?
items.e: Every rectangle already has 4 right angles. A square is a rectangle that also has 4 equal sides.

items.q: Which shape has 4 right angles?
items.e: Shape B has a right-angle mark in all 4 corners. One shape has only 2 right angles, and the others have none.

items.q: What does every square have that not every rhombus has?
items.e: Every rhombus already has 4 equal sides. A square is a rhombus that also has 4 right angles.

items.q: How many right angles does every rectangle have?
items.e: A rectangle is a quadrilateral with 4 right angles. That is what makes it a rectangle.

items.q: Which shape has 4 equal sides?
items.e: Shape B has the same tick mark on all 4 sides. The others have 2 pairs of equal sides, not 4 equal sides.

items.q: How many right angles does this shape have?
items.e: The marks show right angles at 2 corners only. The other 2 angles are not right angles.

items.q: How many right angles does this shape have?
items.e: All 4 corners have the right-angle mark. Every rectangle has 4 right angles, even when it is turned.

items.q: How many right angles does this shape have?
items.e: There are no right-angle marks. A rhombus has 4 equal sides, but its angles are not right angles unless it is a square.

items.q: Which side of rectangle ABCD is parallel to AB?
items.e: AB is the top side and CD is the bottom side. They stay the same distance apart, so CD is parallel to AB.

items.q: Which sides of rectangle ABCD are perpendicular to AB?
items.e: AD and BC meet AB at the corners A and B. Both corners are right angles, so AD and BC are perpendicular to AB.

items.q: How many pairs of parallel sides does a rectangle have?
items.e: AB is parallel to CD, and AD is parallel to BC. That is 2 pairs. (4 is the number of sides.)

items.q: How many pairs of perpendicular sides does a rectangle have?
items.e: Each of the 4 corners is a right angle, and each corner has a pair of perpendicular sides: AB and BC, BC and CD, CD and AD, AD and AB. That is 4 pairs.

items.q: How many pairs of parallel sides does this turned square have?
items.e: Turning a square does not change its sides. Opposite sides still stay the same distance apart: 2 pairs.

items.q: Which side of trapezium ABCD is parallel to AB?
items.e: AB at the bottom and CD at the top both go straight across and stay the same distance apart. So CD is parallel to AB.

items.q: How many pairs of parallel sides does this trapezium have?
items.e: Only AB and CD are parallel. AD and BC get closer at the top. A trapezium has exactly 1 pair of parallel sides.

items.q: Are sides AD and BC of this trapezium parallel?
c: Yes, they are the same length
No, they get closer at the top
items.e: AD and BC lean towards each other: the gap is wider at the bottom than at the top. So they are not parallel.

items.q: Which two sides are perpendicular to AD?
items.e: AD goes straight up. AB and CD go straight across and meet AD at right angles. BC is slanting.

items.q: How many pairs of perpendicular sides does this shape have?
items.e: AB and AD meet at a right angle, and AD and CD meet at a right angle. That is 2 pairs. BC meets the others at a slant.

items.q: What are parallel lines?
c: lines that cross in the middle
lines that stay the same distance apart and never meet
lines that are the same length
lines that meet at a right angle
items.e: Parallel lines always stay the same distance apart, like railway tracks. They never meet, however long they are.

items.q: What do the small arrows on these lines show?
items.e: Matching arrow signs on two lines show that the lines are parallel.

items.q: Which pair of lines is parallel?
items.e: Picture B shows lines that stay the same distance apart all the way along. The lines that get closer would meet if they were longer.

items.q: Which pair of lines is parallel?
items.e: Picture D shows slanting lines that stay the same distance apart. Slanting lines can be parallel too.

items.q: Which pair of lines is parallel?
items.e: Picture A shows two lines of different lengths that stay the same distance apart. Parallel lines do not need to be the same length.

items.q: Which pair of lines is NOT parallel?
items.e: Picture C shows lines that get closer together, so they would meet if they were longer. The other three pairs stay the same distance apart.

items.q: Are lines AB and CD parallel?
c: Yes, they stay the same distance apart
No, they get closer and would meet
items.e: Both lines go straight across and stay 3 squares apart. So they are parallel.

items.q: Are lines AB and CD parallel?
c: No, they get closer and would meet
Yes, they stay the same distance apart
items.e: Both lines go straight up and stay 3 squares apart. Vertical lines can be parallel.

items.q: Are lines AB and CD parallel?
c: Yes, they stay the same distance apart
No, they get closer and would meet
items.e: Both lines go 2 squares right and 4 squares up. They slant the same way, so they are parallel.

items.q: Are lines AB and CD parallel?
c: Yes, they stay the same distance apart
No, they get closer and would meet
No, they are not the same length
items.e: AB goes 6 right and 3 up. CD goes 2 right and 1 up: for every 2 squares right, both go 1 square up. They are parallel even though CD is shorter.

items.q: What 3-D shape is a tin of beans?
items.e: A tin has 2 circle ends and a curved side, so it is a cylinder.

items.q: What 3-D shape is a dice?
items.e: A dice has 6 square faces that are all the same size, so it is a cube.

items.q: What 3-D shape is a football?
items.e: A football is round all over, so it is a sphere. A circle is flat.

items.q: What 3-D shape is a long chocolate box with a triangle at each end?
items.e: 2 triangle ends joined by 3 rectangles make a triangular prism.

items.q: What 3-D shape is an ice-cream cone?
items.e: It has a circle at the top, a curved side and a point at the bottom, so it is a cone.

items.q: What 3-D shape is a cereal box?
items.e: A cereal box has 6 rectangle faces that are not all squares, so it is a cuboid.

items.q: What 3-D shape is an Egyptian pyramid with a square base?
items.e: It has a square base and 4 triangle faces that meet at the top, so it is a square-based pyramid.

items.q: Dev cuts a circle in half with one straight cut through the middle. What shape is each piece?
items.e: Half of a circle is a semicircle. It has 1 curved side and 1 straight side.

items.q: Nisha draws a 2-D shape with 8 straight sides. What is it called?
items.e: 8 sides make an octagon. 6 sides make a hexagon.

items.q: A STOP road sign is an octagon. How many vertices does it have?
items.e: An octagon has 8 sides and 8 vertices.

items.q: Aditi makes 2 cubes from straws. How many straws does she use?
items.e: 1 cube needs 12 straws (12 edges). 2 cubes: 12 + 12 = 24 straws. 16 uses the vertices (8 + 8).

items.q: Siddharth has 20 straws. He makes one cube. How many straws are left?
items.e: A cube uses 12 straws (12 edges). 20 − 12 = 8 straws left. 14 comes from taking away 6 faces instead of 12 edges.

items.q: Rehan makes a triangular prism and a square-based pyramid. He puts a ball of clay at every vertex. How many balls does he use?
items.e: A triangular prism has 6 vertices and a square-based pyramid has 5. 6 + 5 = 11. 17 adds the edges (9 + 8).

items.q: Priya puts a sticker on every face of 3 dice. How many stickers does she use?
items.e: A dice is a cube with 6 faces. 3 dice: 6 + 6 + 6 = 18 stickers. 24 uses the vertices and 36 uses the edges.

items.q: Neha counts all the vertices on 2 square-based pyramids. How many vertices are there?
items.e: Each pyramid has 5 vertices: 4 round the square and 1 at the top. 5 + 5 = 10. 8 forgets the top vertices.

items.q: Anika has a cube, a cylinder, a sphere, a cone and a cuboid. How many of them have a curved surface?
items.e: The cylinder, the sphere and the cone have curved surfaces: 3 shapes. The cube and cuboid have only flat faces.

items.q: Shreya cuts out 3 triangles and 2 squares from card. How many vertices do they have altogether?
items.e: 3 triangles: 3 + 3 + 3 = 9. 2 squares: 4 + 4 = 8. 9 + 8 = 17 vertices. 5 counts the shapes, not the vertices.

items.q: A tin of beans has a paper label all the way round. Which part of the tin does the label cover?
items.e: The label goes round the side of the tin. That is the curved surface of the cylinder. The 2 flat faces are the top and bottom.

items.q: Simran holds a 3-D shape with 6 faces, 12 edges and 8 vertices. Not all of its faces are squares. What shape is it?
items.e: Cubes and cuboids both have 6 faces, 12 edges and 8 vertices. All the faces of a cube are squares, so this is a cuboid.

items.q: Harsh cuts a circle in half with one straight cut through the middle. What shape is each piece?
items.e: Half of a circle is a semicircle. It has 1 curved side and 1 straight side.
